outcome.technical: DESIGN: refuse, not fall back. A tdd/regression task whose tests.gateBasis is `cleared` is now refused wherever a write would leave that state, and `done` refuses to close one. I chose refusal over falling back to the phase gate for three reasons. (1) The fallback answers a request for no gate with a gate nobody named, usually the phase's widest one. (2) The phase gate may itself be empty (P3 in the fixture), so a fallback does not close the state. (3) mode and gate contradict each other and only the caller knows which is wrong, so the refusal names both remedies (`--gate <cmd>` / `--tests-mode gate-only`). An empty task gate with NO basis already falls back to the phase (_manifest_io.gate_entries, _manifest_io.py:689), so the defect state is exactly mode in {tdd, regression} AND gate_cleared(tests). CODE (plugins/audit/scripts/manifest/audit-task.py): new `_OWES_CASE_MODES` (derived from _vocab.TESTS_MODE minus gate-only), `_owed_case_gate_refusal(tid, tests, remedy)` and `_OWED_CASE_WRITE_REMEDY`, placed beside `_retarget_gate_contradiction`. Called from (a) _locked_scope after the widening guard and before any write, judged on the tests block the call leaves, only when the call writes tests; (b) _locked_add, beside _files_gate_refusal; (c) the add --from-file batch loop, beside _files_gate_refusal; (d) _locked_done, right after the not-started refusal and before both close arms (--commit and --no-change). The scope check sits AFTER the started-task widening guard so a started task's mode change still meets the mode refusal first (fg6). The dispatch path is untouched (P153.6). CLOSE PATH TRACED: drive-phase.py close_task (line ~3905) commits via commit-task-work.py or writer_commit and then always runs `audit-task.py done <id> --commit <sha> --from-return`; the no-change exit (drive-phase.py ~6484) runs `done --no-change`. With a cleared gate, run-test-gate.py (~5401) answers empty-gate and exits 0, and commit-task-work.py (docstring 116-121, line 763) commits 'bound to no verdict'. So `done` was the one door, and on HEAD it closed such a task done (ocg8 and ocg9 were red on HEAD with code 0 and status done). Every drive close now goes through the _locked_done refusal. TESTS (tests/test_audit_task.py): a new block `_tdd_gate_clear_cases`, stage `ocg-block`, appended to STAGES. Cases ocg1/ocg1b/ocg2/ocg2b cover scope --gate-clear on tdd/regression: refused, no byte written, both remedies named. ocg3 is the second direction (--tests-mode gate-only --gate-clear allowed). ocg4 covers --tests-mode tdd over a cleared gate. ocg5 pins the existing refusal of a gate-drop of the last entry, which already passed on HEAD. ocg6 is the second direction (a drop that leaves an entry still lands). ocg7 covers add --tests-mode tdd --gate-clear: refused, no id minted. ocg12 covers an add --from-file batch whose tdd task has gate []. ocg8 covers done on a started tdd task with a cleared gate: refused, remedy `scope P2.4 --gate`. ocg11 checks that remedy lands on the started task. ocg9 covers done --no-change on a regression task. ocg10 is the second direction (a gate-only cleared task still closes). EXISTING CASES ADJUSTED, all in my own file, and each was a fixture whose tdd mode was incidental to its point: ag1 now passes --tests-mode gate-only (the title derives tdd; ag2-ag4 and ag8 had cascaded from it). at5-block tg9 now passes --tests-mode gate-only (gb1 had cascaded). The fg fixture's running task is gate-only rather than tdd, because fg4/fg5 clear its gate; fg6's expected text now reads from "gate-only" to "regression". The add --from-file remedy-following case applies the gate_clear edit to tasks[1] (gate-only) rather than tasks[0] (tdd). RUNS: red on HEAD code before the fix, `python3 tests/test_audit_task.py --selftest --stage tg-block` (the block's name before the rename): exit 1, 4/12 cases passed. The failures were tg1, tg1b, tg2, tg2b, tg4, tg7, tg8 and tg9, i.e. ocg1-ocg9 less ocg3/ocg5/ocg6 under today's names; ocg11 and ocg12 were added after the fix and are proven by the mutation rows below. The first full-gate run failed on 23 DUPLICATE CASE ID errors (the `tg` prefix already lives in at5-block) plus the cascades listed above; I renamed my ids to `ocg`.
